property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list and amount, the reference C.transfer must successfully dispatch a well-formed transferFrom(address,address,uint256) call to the recipient contract, so the transfer call succeeds; the mutant hashes the wrong selector, so a recipient that only accepts transferFrom reverts the call and the transfer fails.
change_summary: Change the selector hash string to a non-matching signature, so caddress.call dispatches a different function and the subsequent require(_s) can revert.
